description: Figure 8 presents the distribution of problems based on their correctness when assessed using a Zero-Shot approach, comparing performance with and without knowledge integration. The chart consists of four slices representing different correctness categories. The slice labeled “Correct” is light blue and occupies approximately 68% of the chart. The “Partially Correct” slice is colored dark blue and represents roughly 23% of the total. A smaller slice, “Incorrect”, is colored light gray and accounts for approximately 6% of the chart. Finally, the “No Answer” slice is colored dark gray and makes up about 3% of the chart. The chart includes a legend identifying each slice’s corresponding category and color. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices are visually ordered in descending order based on their proportional size, starting with “Correct” and ending with “No Answer”.
